D: Two stoners wake up with no memory of the night before and no idea where they parked the car.
P: Serve the mains at the Chinese drive-thru scene. And then?
S: Sweet and Dude pork spring rolls
the matching Dude and Sweet tattoos

Crisp pork, cabbage and carrot spring rolls fried golden, with a sweet chilli and lime dipping sauce and fresh coriander on the side. Fry 300g pork mince until browned, add 2 cups finely shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp soy, and cook 3 minutes. Cool completely. Roll 2 tbsp of filling in each of 16 spring roll wrappers, sealing the edge with a little water. Deep fry at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden, then drain on paper towel. Stir the juice of 1 lime into 150ml sweet chilli sauce and serve with coriander.

Popcorn coated in crunchy butter caramel, drizzled with blue-tinted white chocolate and scattered with popping candy for that out-of-this-world crackle. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil and tip into a big bowl, picking out any unpopped kernels. Boil 100g butter, 150g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup for 4 minutes, take off the heat and stir in 1/2 tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt. Pour over the popcorn, toss and spread on a lined tray. Bake at 120C for 20 minutes, stirring once. Melt 100g white chocolate with 2 drops blue colouring, drizzle over and scatter with 2 packets popping candy.
M: And then? Lemon chicken and fried rice
the Chinese drive-thru speaker that keeps saying and then

Crisp battered chicken in a glossy fresh lemon sauce, with egg fried rice, peas and spring onion and a side of garlicky stir-fried broccoli. Cook 300g jasmine rice the day before and chill. Cut 700g chicken thigh into strips, dip in 1 beaten egg, then toss in 100g cornflour. Shallow fry at 180C for 5 minutes until crisp. Simmer the juice of 3 lemons, 80g caster sugar, 150ml water and 1 tbsp cornflour until glossy, and pour over. Fry the cold rice in a hot wok with 2 scrambled eggs, 100g peas, 2 tbsp soy and 3 spring onions. Stir-fry 1 head broccoli with 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes.
W: Fridge full of chocolate pudding pots
the fridge stacked with nothing but pudding

Silky homemade chocolate pudding set in little jars, topped with salted caramel, whipped cream and crushed chocolate biscuit crumbs for crunch. Whisk 80g caster sugar, 30g cocoa, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt in a saucepan, then slowly whisk in 600ml milk. Stir over medium heat until it boils and thickens, about 6 minutes. Take off the heat and stir in 100g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla. Pour into 4 jars, press cling film on top and chill 2 hours. Top each with a spoon of caramel sauce, whipped cream from 200ml thickened cream and 4 crushed chocolate biscuits.
K: Frozen lychees blitzed with lime juice and lemonade into an icy slushie, served in big cups with a lime wheel and a straw. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup, and freeze the fruit flat on a tray for at least 3 hours. Blend the frozen lychees with 100ml of the syrup, the juice of 3 limes and 2 cups of ice until smooth and slushy. Add 600ml cold lemonade and pulse twice to mix without losing the fizz. Pour into 4 big cups and finish each with a lime wheel and a straw.
